decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed erection of single storey side 
conservatory,  because of its position, design and appearance would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of number 12 Meadowbrook Court and is complimentary to the visual amenity of the locality, and would not be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties.  The development is in accordance with the adopted UDP policies ENVB 1.1 (New Development), and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003  and is compliant with  Supplementary Planning Guidance,Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the conservatory hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the conservatory is used.
description: Erection of a single storey side conservatory to existing house.
